conversation: Namaste ji, main solar scheme ke baare mein baat karne ke liye call kar raha hun. Government ki PM-KUSUM yojana ke through aap apne khet mein solar pump lagwa sakte hain.
Arre bhai, ye sab scheme-veme mein bahut dhokha hota hai. Pehle bhi kaha tha koi, kuch nahi mila.
Bilkul samajh sakta hun aapki baat. Lekin ye government ki official scheme hai, 90% subsidy milti hai. Aap sirf 10% paisa lagayenge.
Nahi bhai, mujhe nahi chahiye. Time waste mat karo.
